strings.name: Gautam Adani
strings.summary: Born in Ahmedabad, Adani moved from diamonds and commodity trading into ports, energy, airports and cement, becoming a major infrastructure operator. Expansion brought debt, governance and environmental controversies. The group denied allegations in a 2023 short-seller report. US fraud-related criminal charges followed in 2024; a court dismissed that criminal case in 2026.
strings.coverageNote: Selected verifiable milestones through 13 November 2026; not a live news archive.
strings.influence.rationale: Developed Adani Group’s ports, energy and infrastructure businesses, influencing Indian logistics and industrial development.
